zones.name: King's Pass
zones.fingerprintHint: Desolate tunnels through cliffs west of Dirtmouth, fossilised shells on walls, Lore Tablets, sealed door at far east
zones.note: Former main entryway into Hallownest, fell into disrepair

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub town east of King's Pass, accessible after breaking sealed door
zones.note: Main hub town of Hollow Knight

zones.name: Crystal Peak
zones.note: Most western point connects to King's Pass via Crystal Heart

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.note: Zote is found here held in mandibles of a Vengefly King

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Corridor with storerooms where Zote can be found a second time

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs, presumably captured by beasts here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Has resting area and trials; Zote is final boss of first trial here
zones.note: Contains the first trial where Zote becomes a boss

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where the Love Key is found

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.note: Contains a door unlocked by the Love Key; the Collector boss is fought inside

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; encountered along the path leading to Greenpath

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; grants Rivalry achievement on defeat. Only appears if Knight saved him in both Greenpath and Deepnest.

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside the Tower of Love after unlocking the door with the Love Key

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.grants: Ability to return through eastern entrance of King's Pass; also determines Zote's fate if not saved before acquiring it
abilities.note: Required to re-enter King's Pass from the east; if not obtained before visiting Greenpath, Zote dies if not rescued

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.grants: Allows travel from most western point of Crystal Peak to King's Pass
abilities.note: Used to traverse from Crystal Peak westward into King's Pass

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door inside Tower of Love to fight the Collector
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love. Key item found in Queen's Gardens.
